purpose: Reference environment for SDD envelopes E-S1–E-S3 (SDD §8) and E-O2 (SDD-operator §10), registrar decision 2026-10-28.

referenceEnvironment.node: Node.js 22 LTS (actions/setup-node, node-version 22; exact version recorded per run)
referenceEnvironment.browser: Chromium as installed by Playwright (harness/package.json pins the Playwright version, and with it the Chromium build); exact version recorded per run
referenceEnvironment.hardware: Not fixed. A hosted runner's CPU model, core count and memory vary between runs; each result file records the values the run actually observed. No result claims fixed hardware.

recordedPerRun: CPU model and logical core count

measurementConditions.E-O2: H-O1 (harness/h-o1.mjs): headless Chromium, page served from dist/ on 127.0.0.1, browser context offline after load. Full fixture, default budget, paste fixtures/witnesses/full/proposal-valid.txt; timer from the 'Check reply' click (performance.now() in the harness) until the status shows the validated text and exactly 1 problem row is rendered. 5 measurements in one session; the envelope (≤ 1000 ms) binds the worst.
measurementConditions.E-S1–E-S3: Milestone 4 (OS-6): CLI, cold process start, same runner.

results: Each acceptance run uploads its result files (h-o1-results.json, h-o2-results.json) as workflow artifacts; release measurements are taken on this same environment.
